comparison.objective: Remove a push-and-turn child-resistant bottle cap.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a free bottle while simultaneously pressing and rotating the cap, then lift it off.
comparison.success_condition: Cap is off after sufficient pressed anticlockwise rotation, with no spill or bottle tip; loose cap earns partial credit.
comparison.reason: It shares bounded rotation and a lock condition, but tests coupled push-and-turn removal. The candidate requires separate hex unlocking, bit withdrawal, collar tuning, moving-socket reacquisition, relocking, and measured dynamic trials.
